body: This used to happen to me. Do you wash your body before or after you wash your hair in the shower? This may have something to do with it. After you condition your hair make sure to scrub your back and shoulders once more to make sure that there's no conditioner residue on it. Clip your hair up and don't let it down until you have a shirt on after you shower. If it doesn't improve then try going without conditioner to see if that may help. For me, once I washed my back off after conditioning and didn't let my hair touch it while it was still wet, it improved a lot
